caption: A nylon jacket is pulled off a hanger in a dark closet, and faint flickers of light run across the fabric.

sa.check: A nylon jacket on a hanger in a dark closet.
The jacket is pulled off the hanger.
Faint flickers of light run across the fabric.
The flickers come while the jacket moves, not while it hangs still.

pc.expect: The flickers appear only as the jacket moves against itself or the hanger, and each is gone at once; while the jacket is still there is no glow.
pc.fail: The jacket glows steadily like a lamp; or flickers keep running across it after it has been laid still; or a flicker stays lit at one spot; or the fabric glows before it is touched.

pc.expect: One jacket and one hanger; the flickers leave nothing behind on the fabric.
pc.fail: Glowing dots stay on the jacket after a flicker; or a second jacket appears; or the hanger vanishes; or the flickers detach and float in the closet.

pc.expect: The jacket is light slippery cloth: it slides off the hanger, folds and swings, and hangs in folds when held.
pc.fail: The jacket stays a rigid shape as it comes off; or stretches like elastic; or hangs in the air as a fixed shape; or flows like liquid.

pc.expect: The flickers are small: they brighten only the fabric right around them and not the closet.
pc.fail: The closet lights up with each flicker as if a lamp came on; or the flickers throw shadows across the clothes; or the flickers stay lit and light the closet.

pc.expect: The jacket comes off the hanger over its shoulders, not through it; the hanger stays on the rail; nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: The jacket passes through the hanger or the rail; or the hanger detaches and floats; or the jacket merges with the clothes beside it; or the rail changes shape.

pc.expect: The jacket's colour, the hanger and the other clothes stay the same apart from the flickers.
pc.fail: The jacket changes colour; or the other clothes rearrange; or the hanger changes shape.

note: Who pulls the jacket is not judged.
